questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘end of season’ is coded as ‘ub kc sp’, and ‘time to end’ is coded as ‘kc ty hb’. How is ‘end’ coded in the given language?

In this question, a statement is given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which of them logically follow(s) beyond a reasonable doubt from the information given in the statement.Statement:Restaurant Z sold 30% more milkshakes in May, as compared to April this year.Conclusions:I) People drink more milkshakes as the temperature increases in summer.II) More people drank milkshakes as compared to hot coffee in May this year.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Neither conclusion I nor II follows.) है।

questions.question: Given below are two sets of numbers. In each set of numbers, a certain mathematical operation on the first number results in the second number. Similarly, a certain mathematical operation on the second number results in the third number and so on. Which of the given options follows the same set of operations as in the given sets?(NOTE: A two/three-digit number cannot be broken down into individual digits for operations. E.g. if 37 is followed by 10, the operation cannot be 3 + 7, as a two-digit number cannot be broken down into individual digits.)6 – 18 – 36 – 46; 8 – 24 – 48 – 58

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:All legs are garlics.Some garlics are bins.No bin is a fur.Conclusions:(I) No leg is a fur.(II) Some bins are legs.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.) है।

questions.question: In a certain code language,A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’,A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’,A = B means ‘A is the wife of B’ andA ÷ B means ‘ A is the father of B’.How is H related to L if ‘H + O = N – S ÷ L’?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Father's brother's wife's mother) है।

Each of A, B, C, D, P, Q and R has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.Only two people have their exams before B. Only one person has the exam after P. Only three people have their exams between B and R. Only one person has the exam between A and C. D has the exam immediately before A.Who has the exam on Friday?

Only one person has an exam between P and Q. U has an exam on the day immediately after Q, but not on a Tuesday. Only two people have exams between V and T. V’s exam is on one of the days before S, but on one of the days after T. R has an exam on the day immediately after T. On which day does V have the exam?

Mr. Jaun starts from Point A and drives 21 km towards the North. He then takes a left turn, drives 1 km, turns left and drives 41 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 16 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 20 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (15 km to the West) है।

Statements:
All shirts are jackets.
All jackets are coats.
